earlierRuns: November 13, 2026, 10:30 AM Eastern: 51 of 51 checks, before the owner veto was added to the coin and before the check on the 7-day challenge limit was added. Results at commit 85e0865.

Before that run: the first compile failed (the automatic reader for the full record exceeded the compiler's limit; replaced with recordOf), and one check was written wrong and corrected with the contract unchanged.
limits: Each claim names the system that answers for it. A system outside this network needs proof of its past state, which is still a design question.
The dollar bond is left out, as the legal read recommends.
Nothing here has run on a public network.
